description.narrative: Comoros, HIV, Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Union of the Comoros (DNLS)This program has the following goals: End HIV/AID epidemic in the Union of Comoros by 2030. The objectives of this program are: 50% reduction in new infections by 2019. Ensure 90% of PLHIV are on treatment by 2019
